file: 336 The Arcade Game That Vanished in 1981 Part 1.mp4

lines.t: In 1981, an arcade game showed up in Portland, Oregon. Then it vanished.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: It was called Polybius. A black cabinet, with strange flashing shapes.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: Kids lined up to play it. Then the stories started. Seizures. Nightmares. Memory loss.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: At night, men in black suits came to the machines. They didn't take the coins. They took data.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)

lines.t: Within weeks, every machine was gone. No company. No record. Nothing.

full.credit: Clips: Push Square; Nostalgia Nerd; Gaming Historian (YouTube)
